purpose: Connect one observed missing creation interface to one exact descriptive organ and one explicitly supplied executable package, then compile, materialize, test, and exercise that package in a complete ephemeral request-shaped organ assembly without silently installing it.

properties.request: one normalized creation request that currently reaches exactly one HOLD_MISSING_ORGAN_INTERFACE
properties.anatomy_id: prepare/materialize only; exact descriptive organ ID chosen explicitly by the caller
properties.package: prepare/materialize only; complete explicit axm.executable-software-organ/v0.1 source that cites the anatomy ID and provides the exact missing interface
properties.path: materialize-and-test only; detached candidate directory under creations/ or outside the machine body
properties.checks: materialize-and-test only; optional deterministic checks over the ephemeral complete creation

contains: explicit package and compiled Forge proposal
detached package tests and full ephemeral closure build
separate candidate, installation, registration, promotion, merge, and live-route states

relationships: starts only from a typed creation gap with exactly one missing executable-organ interface
requires the caller to select one exact anatomy record and supply its complete implementation source
requires the supplied package to provide the exact observed missing interface
reuses the organ materialization compiler, detached Creation-Unit Forge test, ephemeral installed-plus-candidate overlay, interface discovery, and validated full assembly
shows when the generic organ-compose capability would gain one request-shaped creation after a separate adoption decision
does not invent source, adopt the candidate, change the live route table, merge, or establish CANON

anatomy_refs.basis: Compiles one exact missing-interface hold, caller-selected anatomy record, and explicit package body into a digest-linked bounded growth plan and existing Forge proposal.
Carries request, gap, census, proposal, package, detached test, and full closure evidence without collapsing their meanings.
Reuses the existing detached package materializer and validated ephemeral assembly builder.

limitations: this version handles exactly one missing interface and one explicit organ package per growth experiment
a passing request-shaped closure proves one exact structural assembly and deterministic validation result, not universal semantic conformance
the capability does not autonomously generate package source or choose an anatomy record
runtime, browser, visual, accessibility, host, and human-quality claims require separate evidence
the tested candidate remains detached and is not installed, registered, promoted, merged, connected to the live library, or made CANON
persistent_state: analyze and prepare are read-only; materialize-and-test writes only the caller-selected detached candidate directory

truth.basis: The exact unsupported request, typed gap, selected anatomy, supplied source, structural tests, full closure result, and unproven behavior remain separately visible.

agency.basis: The caller selects the anatomy and source; no source, admission, installation, promotion, merge, or CANON choice is silently made.

continuity.basis: The live machine and executable-organ library remain unchanged while the candidate and complete closure are tested in detached and disposable spaces.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: One exact gap must be observed, one exact source must validate, and one full request-shaped closure must pass before adoption can even be considered separately.
